Question
========



Welche Aussage zu `stat_summary()` (bei `ggplot2`) ist korrekt?





Answerlist
----------
* summarises the x values for each y value, to draw attention to the summary that you’re computing
* summarises the unique x values for each unique y value, to draw attention to the summary that you’re computing
* summarises the x values
* summarises the x values for each unique y value, to draw attention to the summary that you’re computing
* summarises the y values for each unique x value, to draw attention to the summary that you’re computing



Solution
========

summarises the y values for each unique x value, to draw attention to the summary that you’re computing

vgl. [hier](https://r4ds.had.co.nz/data-visualisation.html#statistical-transformations)
